description: Header file defining the abstract gl::Shader class and its derived classes VertexShader and FragmentShader, implementing OpenGL shader objects and related functionality.

classes.name: ShaderState
classes.description: Holds the state and properties of a shader, including source code, type, version, and compilation status.

classes.name: Shader
classes.description: Represents an OpenGL shader object, managing its lifecycle, source code, compilation, and related properties.

methods.name: setSource
methods.description: Sets the source code for the shader.

methods.name: isCompiled
methods.description: Checks if the shader has been successfully compiled.

methods.name: getInputVaryings
methods.description: Returns the input varyings of the shader.

methods.name: getUniforms
methods.description: Returns the uniforms used in the shader.
